name: Conventional Beam Detector Beamray
summary: BEAMRAY RFX70, 7-70m motorised reflective beam detector 24VDC, comprising 1 x detector head, 1 x system controller and 1 x reflective prism, Auto-alignment, Building Movement Tracking. Operating range up to 70m. Extend to 140m with Long Range Kit (LR140) and to 160m with long Range Kit (LR160)

specs.label: Class-leading speed performance
specs.value: Auto-align time of 3 minutes and 02 seconds recorded at 40 metres.

specs.label: Long Distance Range Kit (LR140)
specs.value: plate of 3 extra reflectors to extend coverage from 70 to 140 metres.

specs.label: Long Distance Range Kit (LR160)
specs.value: plate of 8 extra reflectors to extend coverage from 140 to 160 metres.

features: Conventional Optical Beam Detector with a Distance covering 70 metres which can be extended to 160 metres.
Incorporates linear stepper motors to ensure fast commissioning and routine maintenance.
